notes.title: Meetup with Urban Jungle developers
notes.content: [h1][b]Cake Up & Urban Jungle[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/466ac32fd1be6ddf940aa41ce400a294fae5ff3e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/4020a3099319e7e123732b8e18720812d6502a4d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Today, we were invited to a meeting by our craft colleagues, the gamedev company [b]Kylyk Games[/b] with their game [b]Urban Jungle[/b] which became a nominee in the most cozy game category at Gamescom 2024. [/h3][h3][b]Urban Jungle [/b]- is a cute and meditative simulation game, where you can decorate your home and create a small blooming oasis by arranging a variety of plants.[/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/99359e870bf88c36141247c9ad1b8b86c1d74fa6.jpg"][/img][/h3][h3]Support the developers of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744010/Urban_Jungle/"]Urban Jungle[/url] game and also add our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557380/Cake_Up/"]Cake Up[/url] game to the desired![/h3][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/b6b14d1311ee633b5666f7076473627be2ca4d9d.jpg"][/img][/p]
